title: Round proof upload (POST /api/tournaments/:slug/proofs body)
description: Sender: OpenPairings. One round's pairing proof, sent only when the answer to a publish listed it in `proofs_wanted`. The file is gzip, base64-encoded so the body stays plain JSON; its SHA-256 (of the gzip bytes) and size must be the ones the CURRENT snapshot announces for that round in `rounds[].proof`. Headers as for a publish: `Authorization: Bearer <operator ingest token | installation key orik_...>`, `X-OpenResults-Key` once the slug is claimed. The server checks only the digest, the size and the gzip header; it never runs a verifier. Refusals: 401 unauthorized; 403 key_required, key_mismatch, not_owner, installation_suspended, installation_revoked, address_blocked, tournament_hidden; 404 tournament_not_published; 409 proof_not_announced; 413 proof_too_large (with limit_bytes); 422 invalid_request, proof_mismatch; 503 publishing_paused, storage_low.

gzip_base64.description: The gzip file, standard base64 with padding.
